---
title: "04_describe"
format: html
---

Library
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("ggplot2")
library("purrr")
library("patchwork")
```

Load the clean and augmented data
```{r}
clean_data <- read_tsv(file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Find binary variables and turn them into categorical
```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data |> 
  mutate(
    diabetes = factor(
      diabetes,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no", "yes")
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    chf = factor(
      chf,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("0", "1")
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    death = factor(
      death,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no", "yes")
    )
  )
```


Identify numeric and categorical columns
```{r}
numeric_cols <- clean_data |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  names()

categorical_cols <- clean_data |> 
  select(where(is.character) | where(is.factor)) |> 
  names()
```

Histograms for numeric columns
```{r}
walk(numeric_cols, function(col) {
  clean_data |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 30,
      fill = "steelblue",
      color = "white"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", col),
      x = col,
      y = "Number of participants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("../results/04_describe/", paste0("hist_", col, ".png")),
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
})
```


Bar charts for categorical columns
```{r}
walk(categorical_cols, function(col) {
  clean_data |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_bar(
      fill = "steelblue",
      color = "white"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", col),
      x = col,
      y = "Number of patients"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("../results/04_describe/", paste0("bar_", col, ".png")),
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )
})
```

Combine all numeric plots into one large figure
```{r}
plots <- numeric_cols |> 
  map(function(col) {
    ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_histogram(
        bins = 30,
        fill = "steelblue",
        color = "white"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = col,
        x = NULL,
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  })

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distributions of numeric variables",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
    )
  )

combined_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/04_describe/Numeric_variables_plot.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Combine all categorical variables into one plot
```{r}
plots <- categorical_cols |> 
  map(function(col) {
    clean_data |> 
      count(.data[[col]], name = "n") |> 
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[col]], y = n)) +
      geom_col(
        fill = "steelblue",
        color = "white"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = col,
        x = NULL,
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 45,
          hjust = 1,
          size = 8
        )
      )
  })

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distributions of categorical variables",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
    )
  )

combined_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/04_describe/Character_variables_plot.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```
